description: List tasks with optional filters. Use this to find tasks by status, category, asset, or search term. By default returns titles only; pass include_description: true to also get each task's full description (use this when reviewing tasks for jurisdiction or other content-level changes).

estate_id.description: The estate to act on. Call list_my_estates first to get this id.

include_description.description: When true, include each task's full description in the response. Use when reviewing tasks for content changes (e.g., jurisdiction review). Default false.

limit.description: Max number of tasks to return (default 20)

search.description: Search term to match against task title or description

name: get_tasks
